schedule.title: Smart Scheduling Gantt
schedule.subtitle: Auto-schedule on equipment / person / vehicle time exclusivity and material availability, then adjust and publish
schedule.autoScheduleHint: Tasks are ordered by priority and planned start date; a conflict-free window is found for each person / equipment / vehicle resource, while materials are checked against available stock and shortages are marked as conflicts.
schedule.selectTasksHint: Leave empty to pick unfinished draft and in-progress tasks automatically
schedule.scopeProjectHint: Only schedule tasks belonging to the selected project
schedule.publishHint: Resource time conflicts are re-checked before publishing; publishing occupies resources and writes the schedule back to the tasks
schedule.conflictTip: Conflicting rows must be adjusted or cancelled before publishing
